source: 50 Silver players in Phantom+ replays, 2383 pair fights (sim/scripts/mechanics/wolf_timing.py)
note: start_wolf: share of fights starting in wolf form; holds: equal-probability times (s) of the first transform in the other fights (null = not by 20 s: on cooldown or held)
abilities_note: first cast of each wolf ability in a wolf run, 479 runs: equal-probability times (s) from the run's start (~0.5 s before its first hit; null = not cast in the run)
